# jobtriage database schema

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_skill_refs.py. Do not edit: run the generator. -->

Schema version **3**, rendered from a fresh database.

Read it with `jobtriage db shell "SELECT ..."` or any read-only SQLite
client. Changes go through `jobtriage status`, `jobtriage note` and
`jobtriage attach`; writing the database with SQL bypasses status history,
the actor and the unique key that keeps a re-scrape from duplicating a job.

## jobs

One row per posting the pipeline has seen. `first_seen`, `title`, `published` and `locations` are the first sighting; a later scrape only touches `last_seen` and the pointer data (`url`, `salary`, `source`). `status` and `notes` belong to the person triaging and are never written by a scrape.

| Column | Type | Constraints | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | INTEGER | PRIMARY KEY | stable id; every command and the TUI address a job by this |
| `title` | TEXT | NOT NULL | the board's title, as first seen |
| `company` | TEXT | NOT NULL | as first seen |
| `role` | TEXT | NOT NULL | the relevance role word that matched (software, ...) |
| `year` | INTEGER | NOT NULL | published year; the current year when undated |
| `month` | INTEGER | NOT NULL | published month; the current month when undated |
| `title_key` | TEXT | NOT NULL | folded title; part of the cache key |
| `company_key` | TEXT | NOT NULL | folded company; part of the cache key |
| `url` | TEXT | NOT NULL | the newest posting URL seen |
| `published` | TEXT | — | ISO UTC; NULL when the board gave no date |
| `locations` | TEXT | NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' | JSON array of the board's location strings |
| `salary` | TEXT | — | as the board wrote it; a later sighting never clears it |
| `source` | TEXT | — | the board that served it most recently |
| `first_seen` | TEXT | NOT NULL | when the pipeline first saw it |
| `last_seen` | TEXT | NOT NULL | last scrape that saw it; stale means probably closed |
| `status` | TEXT | NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new' | slug from status.py: new, skipped, to_apply, applied |
| `status_at` | TEXT | — | when status last changed; NULL until it does |
| `notes` | TEXT | — | free text; notes accumulate, newline separated |

Indexes: `idx_jobs_first_seen (first_seen)`, `idx_jobs_published (published)`, `idx_jobs_source (source)`, `idx_jobs_status (status)`
Unique: `title_key, company_key, role, year, month`

## status_history

One row per status change, with who made it. This is what `jobtriage show` prints and what undo reads; the current status also lives on `jobs.status`.

| Column | Type | Constraints | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | INTEGER | PRIMARY KEY | orders two changes in the same second |
| `job_id` | INTEGER | NOT NULL → jobs.id ON DELETE CASCADE | the job the change belongs to; cascades on delete |
| `old` | TEXT | — | the status before; NULL for the first recorded change |
| `new` | TEXT | NOT NULL | the status after |
| `at` | TEXT | NOT NULL | when the change was made (ISO UTC) |
| `actor` | TEXT | NOT NULL | who made it: tui, cli, import or agent |

Indexes: `idx_status_history_job (job_id, at)`

## attachments

One row per file recorded against a job — plan 05 cover letters and the like. `path` is workspace-relative when the file lives in or under the op folder, absolute otherwise.

| Column | Type | Constraints | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | INTEGER | PRIMARY KEY | orders a job's files |
| `job_id` | INTEGER | NOT NULL → jobs.id ON DELETE CASCADE | the job the file belongs to; cascades on delete |
| `kind` | TEXT | NOT NULL | what it is, like 'cover_letter' |
| `path` | TEXT | NOT NULL | where the file lives, in or under the workspace |
| `created_at` | TEXT | NOT NULL | when it was attached (ISO UTC) |

## source_runs

One row per board attempt, success or failure. The health surfaces (`jobtriage sources`, the end of a scrape) summarise the last ten; a row is history about a board name, not a foreign key to one.

| Column | Type | Constraints | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | INTEGER | PRIMARY KEY | orders runs that share a second |
| `source` | TEXT | NOT NULL | a board's canonical NAME |
| `started_at` | TEXT | NOT NULL | when the run began (ISO UTC) |
| `duration_ms` | INTEGER | NOT NULL | how long the registry wrapper took |
| `ok` | INTEGER | NOT NULL | 1 when the board returned, 0 when it raised |
| `fetched` | INTEGER | NOT NULL | rows the board returned, before validation |
| `dropped_invalid` | INTEGER | NOT NULL | rows the contract rejected |
| `error` | TEXT | — | the board's one-line exception; NULL on success |

Indexes: `idx_source_runs_source (source, started_at)`
